title.rendered: So This Happened (EP 406) reviews: Confusion trails Igboho kidnapping intervention

content.rendered:
Fresh debate erupted after reports linked Sunday Igboho to the alleged release of kidnapped victims in Igboho, Oyo State, following a widely publicised ultimatum issued to abductors.

However, conflicting accounts from security authorities have left many Nigerians questioning what truly happened, while the incident has once again highlighted growing concerns over kidnapping and insecurity across the country.
